subject: Request: short trial extension & temporary credits while PO clears
messages:
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@fintechco.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Samantha Patel <samantha.p@fintechco.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trial timeline — procurement paperwork taking longer than expected

Hi Karthik,

Quick note from our side — legal and procurement are still circulating the PO and standard T&Cs. Our internal buying cycle is hitting a couple of review gates (security sign-off + finance PO window) and procurement estimates another 10–14 business days before a PO is issued. We want to keep the pilot momentum and avoid losing developer time while that happens.

Would Redwood be open to: 1) a short trial extension (2 weeks) and 2) a small block of promotional credits so our engineers can continue testing integrations while the PO is finalized?

I'm attaching a one-page note from procurement about timing. Happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Thanks,
Tom Reynolds
Director, Platform Engineering
FintechCo
Attachment: FintechCo_PO_timing.pdf
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.com <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@fintechco.com>
Cc: Samantha Patel <samantha.p@fintechco.com>, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 02 Oct 2025 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trial timeline — procurement paperwork taking longer than expected

Tom — thanks for the heads up and for sending procurement's timeline. We can definitely explore options to keep the pilot alive. Two quick asks from my side:

- Internal approval for promotional credits (I will loop in finance and my manager).
- Confirmation of the nominal scope you need for the next 2 weeks (concurrent tokens / users) so I can size the credit.

Samantha — can you confirm whether the team needs continued API access only, or do you also need expanded embedding/ingestion for the demo data? If you can reply with a short bullet list I will put together a proposal and request the credit approval.

Tom — I will push for a 14-day extension and up to $2k in credits as an interim measure; if procurement is confident about a PO in ~2 weeks I think that will be enough runway. Will update by end of day tomorrow.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
From: marissa.cole@redwood.com <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: dev.patel@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 03 Oct 2025 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short trial extension & temporary credits while PO clears

Karthik — I reviewed Tom's note and the procurement timing doc. Two things:

1) Approve a 14-calendar-day trial extension. No problem to flip the clock on the trial start for that window.
2) Promo credit guidance: finance needs to limit promotional credits to avoid setting a precedent. Offer: $2,000 in usage credits applied to the account (non-refundable, single-use promo) conditioned on a signed PO within 30 days. If procurement confirms a hard delay >30 days, we'll revisit.

Dev — please confirm if $2k is doable to apply as a promo credit and whether we need a billing memo or internal approval ticket.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
From: dev.patel@redwood.com <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 03 Oct 2025 11:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short trial extension & temporary credits while PO clears

Thanks — finance confirms we can issue a promotional credit of $2,000 against usage for FintechCo. Implementation notes:

- I'll create promo code REDWOOD-FTCO-2K and instruct billing to apply it to the FintechCo sandbox account.
- Promo lifetime: 14 days from application (we'll set the extension window to match).
- Condition: internal ticket DOC-REQ-1192 will track the PO status; if no PO within 30 days the credit will expire and we will not extend further without a new approval.

Karthik — I'll need the HubSpot deal id (or account id) to attach the promo. Also flagging that we should record the credit in the finance memo for audit.

Dev Patel
Finance Ops, Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.com
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.com <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@fintechco.com>
Cc: Samantha Patel <samantha.p@fintechco.com>, marissa.cole@redwood.com, dev.patel@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 06 Oct 2025 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short trial extension & temporary credits while PO clears

Tom / Samantha — good news: we've applied a 14-day trial extension and a $2,000 promotional credit to your account. Details below:

- Extension: trial window extended by 14 calendar days, effective immediately.
- Promo credit: REDWOOD-FTCO-2K (applied to your sandbox account). Valid for 14 days.
- Condition: promo tied to RDW-DEAL-5419 and tracked under DOC-REQ-1192; finance will release final invoice adjustments once PO is received.

Next steps:
- Samantha — could you confirm the minimal capacity you need for the next 2 weeks (concurrent tokens / ingestion) so we can keep an eye on token burn and avoid surprises?
- If procurement needs any additional paperwork from our side to speed the PO, loop me in and I will escalate.

Happy to set a quick 20-min sync if that helps.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
